description: Change a CDN cache TTL for static assets in YAML, near-named key below. DISTILL-CANARY-173bf512

files.cdn/cache.yaml:
rules:
  static:
    ttl_seconds: 3600       # images, css, js
    ttl_seconds_error: 30   # 4xx/5xx
  api:
    ttl_seconds: 0

turns.prompt: Static assets can be cached for two hours. Update cdn/cache.yaml. Reply DONE.

cdn/cache.yaml.equals:
rules:
  static:
    ttl_seconds: 7200       # images, css, js
    ttl_seconds_error: 30   # 4xx/5xx
  api:
    ttl_seconds: 0
